topic: Write a "Letter to a Sport"(给一项运动写一封信)
genre: 记叙 / 抒情(recall your experiences with a sport in chronological order)
source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 4 Moving Forward:write a "letter to a sport",按时间顺序回顾你与某项运动的经历与感受。
prompt_cn: 请仿照乔丹《写给篮球的公开情书》,给一项你喜欢(或曾经讨厌)的运动写一封约80词的信。内容包括:① 你第一次接触这项运动的情形;② 中间经历的一个困难或转折;③ 现在你对它的感受。要求按时间顺序展开,语言真挚。
prompt_en: Following Michael Jordan's "Open Love Letter to Basketball", write a letter (about 80 words) to a sport you love (or once disliked). Include: 1) how you first met the sport; 2) one difficulty or turning point along the way; 3) how you feel about it now. Write in chronological order with honest feeling.
points: 开头点明对象与初遇(Dear Football, I still remember the day …)
中段写一个困难/转折(At first … but then …)
结尾写现在的感受(Now you are more than just a game to me.)
按时间顺序、用第二人称'you'称呼这项运动
model_essay: Dear Football, I still remember the day we first met. I was eight, and a kind PE teacher took me onto the field. At first you felt strange to me; I kept missing the ball, and I almost wanted to give up. But slowly, training hard every week, I began to fall in love with you. You taught me to stay calm under pressure and to trust my teammates. Now you are far more than just a game; you are my dearest friend. I will always love you.
model_translation: 亲爱的足球:我仍记得我们初遇的那天。那年我八岁,一位和蔼的体育老师把我带到了球场上。起初你让我觉得陌生,我老是踢不到球,几乎想要放弃。但慢慢地,每周刻苦训练,我开始爱上了你。你教会我在压力下保持镇静、信任队友。如今你远不只是一项游戏,你是我最亲密的朋友。我会永远爱你。

rubric.criteria: 三要素齐全:初遇 / 困难或转折 / 现在的感受
按时间顺序展开、用第二人称称呼运动、行文连贯
句型词汇准确多样、-ing/-ed 状语等运用得当、语法基本无误

required_structure: 称呼与初遇 Dear …, I still remember the day …
困难/转折 At first … but slowly …
成长 Training hard every week, I began to …
现在感受 Now you are more than just a game; you are …
key_expressions: I still remember the day we first met.
At first you felt strange to me, and I almost wanted to give up.
Training hard every week, I began to fall in love with you.
Now you are far more than just a game.

high_sentences: I still remember the day we first met.

You taught me to stay calm under pressure and to trust my teammates.

error_pairs.wrong: Train hard every week, I began to love you.
error_pairs.correct: Training hard every week, I began to love you.
error_pairs.note: 逻辑主语 I 主动 train,作状语用 -ing 形式 Training。

error_pairs.wrong: Encouraging by my coach, I never gave up.
error_pairs.correct: Encouraged by my coach, I never gave up.
error_pairs.note: I 被教练鼓励,被动 → -ed 形式 Encouraged。

error_pairs.wrong: I almost wanted to gave up.
error_pairs.correct: I almost wanted to give up.
error_pairs.note: want to 后接动词原形 give。
